title: Align workflows and Quarkus test deps with 3.39.4
body:
This updates the build configuration to match the intended Quarkus `3.39.4` baseline and removes stale configuration that was causing Actions/build drift. It also applies the Maven-requested relocation from `quarkus-junit5` to `quarkus-junit` across the affected modules.

- **GitHub Actions**
  - Switched every workflow job in `.github/workflows` from `ubuntu-latest` to the explicit Ubuntu 26 runner label: `ubuntu-26.04`
  - Applied the change consistently to:
    - `maven.yml` build and publish jobs
    - `codeql-analysis.yml` analyze job

- **Quarkus test dependency relocation**
  - Replaced `io.quarkus:quarkus-junit5` with `io.quarkus:quarkus-junit` in:
    - `quarkus-hello/pom.xml`
    - `quarkus-world/pom.xml`

- **Quarkus version consistency**
  - Verified the repository stays on Quarkus `3.39.4`
  - Confirmed no remaining `3.39.5` references in the checked-in Maven/workflow configuration

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.quarkus</groupId>
    <artifactId>quarkus-junit</artifactId>
    <scope>test</scope>
</dependency>
```
